title: 近春园 Jinchun Yuan

model.line: Massing only, not a reconstruction: 53 plain blocks (walls, houses, halls), a tinted patch of ground. Its houses, rows and halls are generated to the kind of place, not drawn from a plan of it: assumed (C). The switch `around=0` hides everything outside the walls.

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a neighbouring imperial or princely garden outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: holder not found (crown after 1850, C); 1860 disputed: burned (S1206, 清华园) or partly damaged with the core intact (S1206, 近春园); about 200 rooms pulled down at the end of 1873 for the 圆明园 repair (S1219)

facts.label: Size
facts.value: today's ruin park 6.8 ha, the island 1.3 ha (run, osm ways 84336744, 84273822)

facts.label: Where
facts.value: osm way 84336744 (近春园遗址 park) centroid: the pond and island of the garden

facts.label: Note
facts.value: The west part of 熙春园 from 1822 (春泽园, to 瑞亲王绵忻); Xianfeng's residence as a prince (lead; he was born 1831, so later than 1822). Ruin park 1979, 临漪榭 rebuilt.
